claim: The Zurich annotation assigns the simplex lemma varna- (Grassmann id lemma_varRa_7738) to exactly 23 tokens of the Rigveda, in 23 stanzas and 21 hymns.
locator: lemma_id=lemma_varRa_7738 across rigveda/TEI/rv_book_01..10.tei @ d3eb8af; all 23 listed individually in 03-REGISTERS/rigveda-varna-occurrences.csv; extracted by 04-AUDITS/rv-token-extract.py, censused by 04-AUDITS/rv-varna-census.py
notes: Surface forms: várṇam 18 (ACC.SG), várṇau 1 (ACC.DU, RV 1.179.6c), várṇe 1 (LOC.SG), várṇena 1 (INS.SG), várṇaḥ 1 (NOM.SG), várṇaiḥ 1 (INS.PL) - 23 in total. claim: Grassmann glosses varna- with eight senses in a single undivided string - Farbe, Stamm, Art, Gattung, Partei, Menschenart, Stand, Kaste - and assigns none of them to any particular occurrence.
notes: This is why a sense sort cannot be produced from the corpus as retrieved. The lexicon supplies the range; it does not distribute it. Note also that 'Kaste' is Grassmann's nineteenth-century interpretive category, not an attested Rigvedic sense, and constitution section 7 lists caste among the inherited English categories to be audited before use. Reading the gloss as though it were a per-passage sense assignment would let a dictionary decide the historical question.

claim: By book the 23 tokens fall: book 1 six, book 2 six, book 3 two, book 4 one, book 9 six, book 10 two. Books 5, 6, 7 and 8 carry none.
notes: The second chronological instrument, reported alongside the first per correction C-05. Six of the 23 are in book 9, the Soma mandala, where a colour sense of the purifying draught is the obvious candidate reading - but that is a reading, not a measurement, and it is not made here. Of the family books 2-7, three carry no occurrence (5, 6 and 7); books 2, 3 and 4 do. Book 8 also carries none but is not a family book. An earlier version of this note said 'four family books of six' and was wrong on both the count and the membership.

claim: A further 23 tokens of the Rigveda belong to 12 distinct compound lemmas built on -varna-, headed by hiranyavarna- 'goldfarben' with 9. The simplex and the compounds are the same size.
locator: same extraction; candidates found by an accent-stripped string test over lemma strings, then adjudicated one by one on Grassmann's gloss in rigveda/info/matched_lemmata.json; all 12 in, all 4 out and both derivatives enumerated with their glosses in the output of 04-AUDITS/rv-varna-census.py
notes: Recorded because a page saying 'all 23 occurrences' makes a completeness claim that is exact for the simplex lemma and, unqualified, silent about the compounds. CORRECTED after adversarial review, which found the first version wrong in both directions and logged as BF-016; it read 24 tokens over 13 lemmas. Two errors. (1) The string test was accent-sensitive, so it missed suvarna- 'schoenfarbig' - BF-008's control applies and the script now states that it strips the combining acute and grave and nothing else. (2) Membership was decided on the string, which admits four lemmas that are not varna- compounds at all: svarnara- (13 tokens) and svarnar- (1), which are svar + nara-, and madhvarnas- 'suesse Wogen habend' and dhanvarnas- 'das Gestade ueberflutend', both from arnas- 'wave, flood'. Membership is now decided on Grassmann's gloss, as the pur- family decides it. The old figure of 24 was ABOVE the true count, so calling it a floor was wrong as well. Two further tokens, sa-varni- and savarnya-, are Grassmann proper names derived from the compound savarna-; they are reported by the script and NOT counted, and the choice is recorded here because it is a judgement. Note for the sense question: dhrsadvarna- is glossed 'von kuehner Art', so a non-colour sense of varna- is already present inside the compounds. That is an observation about the compounds and not a result about the 23.
